user.title: Moin Hamburg
user.description: A drawn Hamburg skyline as dashboard background that follows the weather, warnings and special days. Only the weather is required.

data.event_calendars: Calendars with Hamburg events, birthdays and school holidays
data.water_level: Water level at Hamburg St. Pauli
data.default_theme: Make Moin Hamburg the default theme

data_description.weather: A weather entity with an hourly forecast, for example Met.no or DWD.
data_description.warnings: NINA warnings (the warning binary sensors or their headline sensors) or the DWD warning level sensors. Storms, storm surges, thunder, heat, severe frost and snow show in the picture.
data_description.event_calendars: Events count by their title, for example “Dom”, “Hafengeburtstag”, “Geburtstag Kim” or “Herbstferien”. The keywords can be changed in the options. Holidays need no calendar.
data_description.bin_calendars: Any event on a day means a collection: the bin lorry drives through the picture from 6 to 10 in the morning.
data_description.water_level: The PEGELONLINE gauge “HAMBURG ST. PAULI” (a Home Assistant integration). The Elbe in the picture rises and falls with the tide, and from 1.5 m above mean high tide it floods the quay as a storm surge.
data_description.default_theme: For all users and devices. Without it, pick “moin-hamburg” or “moin-hamburg-still” in your profile.

error.not_st_pauli: This is not the gauge Hamburg St. Pauli. The tide marks only fit that one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Moin Hamburg is already set up.

data_description.schnack: With German as the Home Assistant language: “Moin” all day, “Schietwetter” for rain, Low German wishes.
data_description.ais_key: Optional. A free key from aisstream.io (sign in with GitHub, then Account). With it, Moin Hamburg keeps one connection to aisstream.io and shows cruise ships at the terminal and big container ships under way. Only the key and a window around the harbour are sent.

keywords.name: Calendar keywords
keywords.description: Separated by commas. A keyword matches the start of an event title up to the end of a word, ignoring case; * stands for any text, as in “*ferien”. Birthdays take the name from the rest of the title.

error.ais_cannot_connect: aisstream.io did not answer. Try again later.

themes_not_loaded.title: The Moin Hamburg themes are not loaded
themes_not_loaded.description:
The integration writes its themes to `themes/moin-hamburg.yaml` in your configuration folder, but Home Assistant does not load themes from there. Add this to `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```
